prs.title: Jp/metric filtering and editing
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: 971 custom lines across 18 files introducing metric filtering and editing functionality, touching schema, seeding, multiple UI components, and a new filterable grid component represents a significant feature with broad surface area.

stories.name: Metric Filtering and Editing Experience
stories.rationale: Enabled users to filter and edit metrics within the platform, improving usability and control over business readiness data.
